title: Ajob Premer Golpo
desc: Dipto, a cheerful young man, falls in love with Sulgana, who is much older than him. However, things escalate when their families object to their relationship because of their age gap.

title: Sakaler Sure
desc: Talented singers and artists perform some of the most popular devotional and folk songs of Bengali music and enthral the audience with their performance.

title: Inspector Notty K
desc: Notty, a police constable eager for promotion, agrees to his boss's request to bring the boss's daughter home from Italy, hoping this task will lead to career advancement.

title: Pooja
desc: A maidservant witnesses the horrific tortures subjected to her employer's daughter by her in-laws. Eventually, she hatches a plot to infiltrate the house and rescue her mistress.

title: Projapati
desc: A 65-year-old retired widower, living alone with his son Joy, hopes he will marry to ease his loneliness. However, Joy, a busy wedding planner, has no plans to settle down anytime soon.

title: Rupban
desc: A 12-year-old Rupban is married to Rahim when he is just 12 days old. However, their lives take a turn when Rahim grows older, only to refuse to accept Rupban as his wife and fall in love with Tajel.

title: Dhumketu
desc: In the mountainous region of North Sikkim, a tea plantation supervisor finds himself unemployed. With few career opportunities available in the area, he finds ways to support his family.
